name: Lena
source:
An Elf chieftain with a calm and honest personality.
She has been alive for thousands of years and became an enlightened person who doesn't feel any kind of worldly desire.
Despite her gentle nature, she can be firm and determined when it comes to matters regarding her elvish people.
translation:
An Elf chieftain with a calm and honest personality.
She has been alive for thousands of years and became an enlightened person who doesn't feel any kind of worldly desire.
Despite her gentle nature, she can be firm and determined when it comes to matters regarding her elvish people.
